title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Smoky BBQ Sauce
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring shrimp marinated in a smoky BBQ sauce and grilled to perfection. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: 2. Thread shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together BBQ sauce, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
4. Brush the shrimp with the BBQ sauce mixture, making sure they're fully coated.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
6. Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
8. Discard any leftover BBQ sauce mixture and skewers.
